routes.name: Skilled Worker
routes.summary: An eligible job with a licensed employer. Check the occupation, salary, English requirement and exact offer before applying.
routes.watch: A sponsor licence alone does not mean the employer will sponsor your role.
routes.next: Compare the advert with the employer's written sponsorship policy.

routes.name: Health and Care Worker
routes.summary: For eligible health and care roles with an approved employer. The job, employer and professional registration requirements matter.
routes.watch: Overseas recruitment for care workers and senior care workers has closed. Other eligible occupations have different rules.
routes.next: Check the precise occupation and application location in the official guide.

routes.name: Student
routes.summary: For an eligible course, a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies and the required finances and English evidence.
routes.watch: Permission depends on your course and conditions. Students cannot normally be self-employed or run a business.
routes.next: Verify the provider, course, total cost and CAS conditions before paying.

routes.name: Graduate
routes.summary: For eligible graduates applying in the UK after their institution reports successful completion. Check your current permission and deadline.
routes.watch: The published duration is two years for applications by 31 December 2026, and 18 months from 1 January 2027. Doctoral graduates have separate three-year provision.
routes.next: Check your likely application date. It cannot be extended and does not itself provide a direct settlement route.

routes.name: India Young Professionals Scheme
routes.summary: A ballot-based route for eligible Indian citizens aged 18–30, with a qualifying degree and required savings.
routes.watch: Selection is not guaranteed. A route being listed here does not mean a ballot is open.
routes.next: Check the official ballot notice and full eligibility rules; never pay someone to guarantee selection.

routes.name: High Potential Individual
routes.summary: For eligible recent graduates of universities on the qualifying list for their graduation year. A job offer is not required.
routes.watch: Your university, award and graduation date must qualify. A UK degree is not eligible for this route.
routes.next: Check the correct annual university list and qualification verification process.

routes.name: Global Talent
routes.summary: For leaders or potential leaders in specified research, arts and digital technology fields, through the relevant endorsement or eligible prize pathway.
routes.watch: A strong CV alone does not establish eligibility; evidence must meet the route's specific requirements.
routes.next: Read the endorsement guidance for your exact field before preparing evidence.

routes.name: Innovator Founder
routes.summary: For a new business idea assessed by an approved endorsing body as innovative, viable and scalable.
routes.watch: Ordinary company registration is insufficient. Business funding, personal maintenance and endorsement costs are separate.
routes.next: Test the commercial case and endorsement fit before buying an immigration package.

routes.name: UK Expansion Worker
routes.summary: For qualifying overseas businesses sending eligible senior employees to establish a UK presence that has not started trading.
routes.watch: This is not a general route for a new solo business and is not a direct settlement route.
routes.next: Check the overseas business history, employment, sponsorship and UK expansion requirements.

routes.name: Scale-up Worker
routes.summary: Initially requires an eligible sponsored job with an approved scale-up business. Later permission has distinct earnings conditions.
routes.watch: An employer describing itself as a startup does not make it an approved scale-up sponsor.
routes.next: Check the employer's licence category, qualifying role and earnings rules.

routes.name: Family visa
routes.summary: For qualifying family relationships and circumstances. Relationship, financial and other evidence varies by application.
routes.watch: This is a separate assessment, not an employment or study shortcut.
routes.next: Use the guide for the specific family relationship and seek regulated advice where needed.
